opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel awards up to £2,000-£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. UK-originating projects apply to the UK office; Japan-originating projects to the Japan office. Previous recipients welcome.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that might otherwise not be possible, bringing people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits. UK office holds three annual awards meetings (deadlines 31 March, 15 September, 15 December); Japan office holds two (28 February, 30 September).

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants. Apply to the UK (London) office regardless of where based.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs. Annual deadline 1 December for a decision in March of the following year (moved from 15 December prior to 2026).
